notes: I couldn't read the RFP body or find an award. The PDF is Flate-compressed. WebFetch returned only the metadata, and the Read tool's PDF mode needs pdftoppm, which isn't installed. I had no shell tool, so I couldn't run pypdf or pdftotext. Search snippets show the RFP is for whole genome sequencing of human biospecimens from participating academic medical centers. It covers DNA QC, library prep, and sequencing at 'research-grade coverage'. Proposals were due 17 Apr 2026, 11:59 PM, submitted through Submittable. The questions contact is BioBank@masslifesciences.com. Optional certifications mentioned include CLIA, CAP, ISO 9001, ISO 20387, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001. Snippets gave no sample count, platform requirement, price ceiling, scoring weight or award. The sibling Transcriptomics RFP lists cost among its evaluation criteria, but I couldn't confirm that for the WGS RFP. Two searches found no award news. MLSC is a state agency and may never publish a per-genome price for this buy, so even a local extraction may find only the RFP terms.
